actions.description: ERP dashboard as of the simulation date: factories (capacity, machines, staff), alerts from the shop floor and warehouse, and business KPIs (late orders, material shortages). Start here.
actions.name: get_overview

actions.description: Business KPI of the plan right now: orders expected late, sofas late, unplanned orders, orders late without customer notice, material shortages, cost of measures. This is the measure of success.
actions.name: get_kpi

actions.description: WHAT-IF, read-only. Applies one change, or a SEQUENCE of changes (parameter "changes", applied in order), of the ERP change tools (create_purchase_order, update_production_order, create_production_order, request_overtime, request_temp_workers, write_off_stock, release_stock ...) to a COPY of the company state and returns what each would answer plus the KPI before and after. Nothing is changed. Single options often are not enough: test COMBINATIONS (for example two purchase orders plus overtime) and compare them. Apply the chosen changes only in the execute step.

input.description: Name of an ERP change tool (single change)
input.name: tool

input.description: A sequence of changes to apply together
input.name: changes

actions.name: simulate_change
